## Checklist

- [ ] Integration tests ran against a real PostgreSQL (`TEST_DATABASE_URL` set)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by a test
- [ ] Documentation affected by this change is updated in this same pull request
- [ ] No secret, token, real hostname or real course content is included
- [ ] No new dependency, or the pull request explains why one is needed
